steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Soak pitted dates in warm water for 5 minutes, drain, then finely chop them.
In a large bowl, combine mashed banana, coconut milk, and melted coconut oil.
Add oat flour, baking powder, and cinnamon to the bowl and stir until just combined.
Fold the chopped pitted dates evenly through the batter.
Drop heaped tablespoons of batter onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them 3 cm apart.
Bake for 14 to 16 minutes, until the bites are set and lightly golden on the bottom.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes before serving; store in an airtight container for up to 4 days.
